Refused since 0.49.1 with 'the drop found no foot point': the drop of the shared edge onto the turned face starts where that face meets its axis, a singular point, and just past it the edge leaves the face, so the drop of the next point, bounded by the curve-on-surface distance, rightly finds no point within the bound; that was taken as an error.
